capabilities: Install bundled blank report templates and database views
Apply optional vault settings and hotkeys
Organize work and personal notes with notebooks and tags
Create vault-local backups and restore imports
Run optional AI writing and video metadata lookups
extras: Not yet tested in a real Obsidian UI; physical iPhone/iPad testing is pending and cold-start color flashing remains under investigation. Some inherited features still assume the .obsidian folder. Chinese interface (自媒体工作台). Removing the plugin keeps installed templates and settings; recovery journals may contain pre-import settings and must not be shared. Vault-local backups share the vault's sync fate, so a separate external backup is advised.
problem: Building a personal workbench with templates, views, styles, and vault preferences from scratch is tedious and must be repeated on every device.
